est.columns_from: column names in the header row

definitions.reference: built from the truth notes on a 10 ms grid from 0 s to duration_s: frequency of the sounding note (440 * 2^((pitch + tuning_offset_cents/100 - 69)/12)) where a reference note sounds (onset <= t < offset), 0 (unvoiced) elsewhere; where notes overlap the later onset wins. Which notes: truth notes with voice 'melody'
definitions.resampling: mir_eval.melody.to_cent_voicing(ref_time, ref_freq, est_time, est_freq): the estimate is linearly interpolated onto the reference grid; frequency <= 0 means unvoiced
definitions.voicing_recall: mir_eval.melody.voicing_recall: fraction of reference-voiced frames the estimate marks voiced
definitions.voicing_false_alarm: mir_eval.melody.voicing_false_alarm: fraction of reference-unvoiced frames the estimate marks voiced
definitions.raw_pitch_accuracy: mir_eval.melody.raw_pitch_accuracy(cent_tolerance=50): fraction of reference-voiced frames where the estimate's frequency is within 50 cents (strictly less), voicing decision ignored
definitions.raw_chroma_accuracy: mir_eval.melody.raw_chroma_accuracy(cent_tolerance=50): the same with octave errors ignored
definitions.overall_accuracy: mir_eval.melody.overall_accuracy(cent_tolerance=50): fraction of all frames where the two agree: unvoiced in both, or voiced in both with the pitch less than 50 cents apart

processing: --conf-threshold 0.9: 527 frames with confidence below it were marked unvoiced by negating their frequency (mir_eval convention: still used for raw pitch and raw chroma accuracy)
